questions.stem: What is a major challenge of recycling plastics?

options.text: There are many different types of plastic that usually cannot be mixed, making sorting difficult
Recycled plastic is more expensive than gold
Plastics decompose too quickly to be collected

questions.explanation: Plastic recycling is challenged by the many different polymer types (PET, HDPE, PVC, LDPE, PP, PS, etc.) that usually cannot be mixed together during recycling. Sorting is difficult and expensive, contamination from food residue is problematic, and recycled plastic is often downcycled to lower-quality products.
